snippet.title: Omega Timeline: Poppy's Story ~ A ChristmAUs Carol (Release Trailer)
snippet.description:
Following an unexpected Snowstorm hitting the Omega Timeline, Poppy and Cadence find themselves trapped in a part of the timeline's residential areas. As such, they must way to pass the time by speaking with the hundred or so people who find themselves in their same situation until people arrive to help.

Poppy's Story ~ A ChristmAUs Carol (Also known as ChristmAUs 2023) is an UNDERTALE fangame made in collaboration with many members of the fandom!

Get it NOW!
